propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, creating a contract mismatch in assignee resolution

PR #120's resolve_assignee copy hardcoded is_account_id=False and consulted an unset _assignee_resolver attribute, making the authoritative branch unreachable and causing permanent non-authoritative resolution that drives assignee churn

A UserIdentityModel protocol with two implementations (AccountIdIdentity for Cloud, NameIdentity for DC) must define resolve() returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) and to_payload() returning the deployment's assignee field shape

NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and enable diff convergence, with resolver injected explicitly at construction rather than discovered via getattr

Data Center assignee resolution must return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees to prevent re-emission of assignee changes; unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative values
